1.t: The Hour has drawn near and the moon was split ˹in two˺

2.t: Yet, whenever they see a sign, they turn away, saying, “Same old magic!”
2.tr: Wa-ien yaraw aayataien yu'ridoo Wa-yaqooloo sihrun mustamirr

3.t: They rejected ˹the truth˺ and followed their own desires—and every matter will be settled—
3.tr: Wa-kazzaboo wattaba'ooo ahwaaa'ahum; Wa-kullu amrin mustaqirr

4.t: even though the stories ˹of destroyed nations˺ that have already come to them are a sufficient deterrent
4.tr: Wa-laqad jaaa'ahum minal anbaaa'i maa feehi muzdajar

5.t: ˹This Quran is˺ profound ˹in˺ wisdom, but warnings are of no benefit ˹to them˺

6.t: So turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺. ˹And wait for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the caller will summon ˹them˺ for something horrifying
6.tr: Fatawalla 'anhum; yawma yad'ud daa'i ilaa shai-'in nukur

7.t: With eyes downcast, they will come forth from the graves as if they were swarming locusts
7.tr: Khushsha'an absaaruhum yakhrujoona minal ajdaasi ka-annahum jaraadum muntashir

8.t: rushing towards the caller. The disbelievers will cry, “This is a difficult Day!”
8.tr: Muhti'eena ilad daa'i yaqoolul kaafiroona haazaa yawmun 'asir

9.t: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺ and rejected Our servant, calling ˹him˺ insane. And he was intimidated
9.tr: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Noohin fakazzaboo 'abdanaa Wa-qaaloo majnoonunw wazdujir

10.t: So he cried out to his Lord, “I am helpless, so help ˹me˺!”

11.t: So We opened the gates of the sky with pouring rain

12.t: and caused the earth to burst with springs, so the waters met for a fate already set
12.tr: Wa-fajjarnal arda 'uyoonan faltaqal maaa'u 'alaaa amrin qad qudir

13.t: We carried him on that ˹Ark made˺ of planks and nails

14.t: sailing under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes—a ˹fair˺ punishment on behalf of the one ˹they˺ denied
14.tr: Tajree bi-a'yuninaa jazaaa'an liman kaana kufir

15.t: We certainly left this as a sign. So is there anyone who will be mindful
15.tr: Wa-laqat taraknaahaa aayatan fahal min muddakir

16.t: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings

17.t: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
17.tr: Wa-laqad yassarnal Qur'aana liz-zikri fahal min muddakir

18.t: ’Ȃd ˹also˺ rejected ˹the truth˺. Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings

19.t: Indeed, We sent against them a furious wind, on a day of unrelenting misery
19.tr: Innaa arsalnaa 'alaihim reehan sarsaran fee Yawmi nahsin mustamirr

20.t: that snatched people up, leaving them like trunks of uprooted palm trees
20.tr: Tanzi'un naasa ka-annahum a'jaazu nakhlin munqa'ir

21.t: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings

22.t: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
22.tr: Wa-laqad yassarnal Qur'aana liz-zikri fahal min muddakir

24.t: arguing, “How can we follow one ˹average˺ human being from among us? We would then truly be misguided and insane
24.tr: Faqaalooo a'-basharan minnaa waahidan nattabi'uhooo innaa izal lafee dalaalinw Wa-su'ur

25.t: Has the revelation been sent down ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us? In fact, he is a boastful liar.”
25.tr: A-ulqiyaz zikru 'alaihi min baininaa bal huwa kazzaabun ashir

26.t: ˹It was revealed to Ṣâliḥ,˺ “They will soon know who the boastful liar is

27.t: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them ˹closely˺, and have patience
27.tr: Innaa mursilun naaqati fitnatan lahum fartaqibhum wastabir

28.t: And tell them that the ˹drinking˺ water must be divided between them ˹and her˺, each taking a turn to drink ˹every other day˺.”
28.tr: Wa-nabbi'hum annal maaa'a qismatun bainahum kullu shirbin muhtadar

29.t: But they roused a companion of theirs, so he dared to kill ˹her˺

30.t: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings

31.t: Indeed, We sent against them ˹only˺ one ˹mighty˺ blast, leaving them like the twigs of fence-builders
31.tr: Innaaa arsalnaa 'alaihim saihatanw waahidatan fakaanoo kahasheemil muhtazir

32.t: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
32.tr: Wa-laqad yassarnal Qur'aana liz-zikri fahal min muddakir

33.t: The people of Lot ˹also˺ rejected the warnings

34.t: We unleashed upon them a storm of stones. As for ˹the believers of˺ Lot’s family, We delivered them before dawn
34.tr: Innaa arsalnaa 'alaihim haasiban illaaa aala Lootin najjainaahum bisahar

35.t: as a blessing from Us. This is how We reward whoever gives thanks
35.tr: Ni'matan min 'indinaa; kazaalika najzee man shakar

36.t: He had already warned them of Our ˹crushing˺ blow but they disputed the warnings

37.t: And they even demanded his angel-guests from him, so We blinded their eyes. ˹And they were told,˺ “Taste then My punishment and warnings!”
37.tr: Wa-laqad raawadoohu 'an daifeehee fatamasnaaa a'yunahum fazooqoo 'azaabee Wa-nuzur

38.t: And indeed, by the early morning they were overwhelmed by an unrelenting torment

39.t: ˹Again they were told,˺ “Taste now My punishment and warnings!”

40.t: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
40.tr: Wa-laqad yassarnal Qur'aana liz-zikri fahal min muddakir

41.t: And indeed, the warnings ˹also˺ came to the people of Pharaoh

42.t: ˹But˺ they rejected all of Our signs, so We seized them with the ˹crushing˺ grip of the Almighty, Most Powerful
42.tr: Kazzaboo bi-Aayaatinaa kullihaa fa-akhaznaahum akhza 'azeezim muqtadir

43.t: Now, are you ˹Meccan˺ disbelievers superior to those ˹destroyed peoples˺? Or have you ˹been granted˺ immunity ˹from punishment˺ in divine Books
43.tr: A-kuffaarukum khairun min ulaaa'ikum am lakum baraaa'atun fiz Zubur

44.t: Or do they say, “We are all ˹a˺ united ˹front˺, bound to prevail.”

45.t: ˹Soon˺ their united front will be defeated and ˹forced to˺ flee

46.t: Better yet, the Hour is their appointed time—and the Hour will be most catastrophic and most bitter
46.tr: Balis Saa'atu maw'iduhum was-Saa'atu adhaa Wa-amarr

47.t: Indeed, the wicked are ˹entrenched˺ in misguidance, and ˹are bound for˺ blazes

48.t: On the Day they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, ˹they will be told,˺ “Taste the touch of Hell!”
48.tr: Yawma yus-haboona fin Naari 'alaa wujoohihim zooqoo massa saqar

49.t: Indeed, We have created everything, perfectly preordained

50.t: Our command is but a single word, done in the blink of an eye
50.tr: Wa-maaa amrunaaa illaa waahidatun ka-lamhin bil-basar

51.t: We have already destroyed the likes of you. So will any ˹of you˺ be mindful
51.tr: Wa-laqad ahlaknaaa ashyaa'akum fahal min muddakir

52.t: Everything they have done is ˹listed˺ in ˹their˺ records

53.t: Every matter, small and large, is written ˹precisely˺

54.t: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and rivers

55.t: at the Seat of Honour in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign
